scope.excluded: F2-S1 already has separate source-bound full-window canary requests; it is not duplicated here

source_binding_policy.current_xml_bi4_receipts: exact CURRENT graph row source XML, same-stem native BI4, current GenCase receipt and completed solver receipt
source_binding_policy.physical_identity: exact graph sentinel physical_case_id; no latest glob or family alias
source_binding_policy.same_cfl: direct immutable CURRENT original source prefix
source_binding_policy.half_cfl: new overlay changes only both XML cflnumber values to source CFL/2; source particle BI4 and motion dependencies are byte-identical

cost_policy.raw_native: complete physical window and every dense saved frame retained; reserved bytes use graph actual source Part_0000 size × planned frame count plus safety factor

stream_observer.mode: one sequential pass; derived observables do not replace raw

cost_policy.typed: selected query anchors only; no second full H5 copy in these requests
cost_policy.downsample: derived from retained dense native output; no additional solver
cost_policy.lossless_full_window: separate postrun reconstruction plan; full-time bytes and ratio UNKNOWN until an end-to-end roundtrip canary
cost_policy.two_frame_ratio: retained only as diagnostic context and excluded from reservation

aggregate.proxy_warning: planning proxy only; actual guarded solver receipt and terminal storage check are authoritative
